sentences.text: G'day, and welcome.
If you are watching this tape, your results have been released.
One of them was an N.
sentences.say: One of them was an, en.

sentences.text: No worries. Failing a unit is a normal part of uni life.
sentences.say: No worries. Failing a unit is a normal part of uni life.

sentences.text: Here at Monash, we make sure of it.
Please follow the rules on this tape. They are for your protection.
Results are released at 9:00 am.
sentences.say: Results are released at nine a.m..

sentences.text: If an email about your result arrives before 9:00 am, do not open it.
sentences.say: If an email about your result arrives before nine a.m., do not open it.

sentences.text: We do not send emails before 9:00 am.
sentences.say: We do not send emails before nine a.m..

sentences.text: Your final mark is 49.
It is always 49.
Do not ask where the other mark went.
It has been put to good use.
You may ask to view your exam paper.
The handwriting on it should be yours.
If it is not, hand it back, say "no worries", and leave the room.
sentences.say: If it is not, hand it back, say, no worries, and leave the room.

sentences.text: Do not read what it wrote.
You may be offered a supp exam. The fee is payable in person at the service counter.
sentences.say: You may be offered a supp exam. The fee is payable in person, at the service counter.

sentences.text: There is one service window.
If you can see a second window, do not join that queue.
Nobody in that queue is enrolled.
Your supp exam will be held in the Menzies Building.
The Menzies Building has eleven floors.
If the lift shows a button for a twelfth, do not press it.
You have not studied for that floor.
There are three invigilators in the exam room.
Count them at the start. Count them again during reading time.
If there are four, keep your eyes on your own paper.
The fourth is not looking for cheating.
If you fail the supp, you must repeat the unit.
Enrol in WES before the census date.
sentences.say: Enrol in wez, before the census date.

sentences.text: Fees are charged for every attempt.
There is no limit on attempts. We checked.
You may notice a new building on campus.
It was not there last semester.
Do not look for your name on the donor wall.
If you find it, do not count how many times it appears.
The 601 leaves the Clayton bus loop for Huntingdale every few minutes.
sentences.say: The six oh one leaves the Clayton bus loop, for Huntingdale, every few minutes.

sentences.text: If a bus arrives showing route 49, it is not a bus.
sentences.say: If a bus arrives showing route forty-nine, it is not a bus.

sentences.text: Do not touch on.
A pass grade does exist. Some students have seen one.
If a mate reckons they passed this unit, ask who their lecturer was.
If they cannot remember the lecturer's face, they are not your mate anymore.
They are staff.
If you have followed every rule, you will be allowed to attempt the unit again.
And again.
And again.
Monash thanks you for your continued enrolment.
Ancora imparo. I am still learning.
sentences.say: Ancora imparo. I am still learning.

sentences.text: See you next semester.
